Teaching

I have taught undergraduate, MSc, and PhD courses across five institutions, spanning computer networks, distributed systems, computer architecture, and telecommunications. My experience includes coordinating more than ten courses and teaching both large classes and small research seminars.

Recent courses at Técnico

  • Advanced Topics in Networked Distributed Systems2026/27
  • Computer Networks2026/27
  • Computer Organization2026/27
  • Introduction to Computer Architecture2025/26

I coordinate the Master’s Programme in Telecommunications and Informatics Engineering (METI).
